note: TEST ONLY — public/private keypair committed so negative control C10 is reproducible. This key is NOT enrolled: it appears in no enrolled_keys list in interop/psea/psea-fixture-v0.json and no DID document under testkeys/did-documents/. Its only use is to sign a PSEA token that claims a kid it does not hold. DO NOT USE IN PRODUCTION.
curve_note: EC P-256, unlike the Ed25519 keys beside it: the counterpart profile draft-yossif-psea-02 signs with ES256, so an attacker key that a PSEA verifier would even attempt has to be on the same curve.
derivation: Deterministic, so the control reproduces byte for byte without committing a signature: private scalar = int.from_bytes(sha256(b"aae-conformance-vectors/psea-attacker-key/v1"), "big") mod n, where n is the P-256 group order. The Ed25519 keys in this directory were generated randomly once by tools/genkeys.py and committed; this one is derivable instead, which a reviewer can check without trusting the committed bytes.
